# KayKit - Character Pack: Adventurers

- Version: Free 2.0
- Author: Kay Lousberg
- Source: https://kaylousberg.itch.io/kaykit-adventurers
- License: Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal (CC0 1.0)
- Downloaded: 2026-08-04

This project contains the Unity-oriented FBX files only:

- `Characters/` — five characters plus the hooded Rogue variant and textures.
- `Animations/` — the bundled general and basic movement animation libraries.
- `Props/` — weapons, shields and accessories.

GLTF and OBJ duplicates and paid-tier content are intentionally excluded.
